policy: Every shipped workflow must have a no-subscription execution path.

sources.name: Codex native web research
limitations: availability depends on the active Codex environment
results must be dated and cited

sources.name: Direct public-page inspection
limitations: respect robots and site terms
bounded crawling only

sources.name: Google Trends Trending Now export and RSS
limitations: relative signal rather than exact volume
market and time window must match
one trend feed alone is not cross-source confirmation

sources.name: Sitemaps and robots declarations
limitations: declared URLs are not proof of indexation

sources.name: Common Crawl
limitations: coverage is incomplete
graph releases are periodic
bulk use requires offline datasets

sources.name: Registration Data Access Protocol
limitations: registries may redact fields
registration data is not an authority score

sources.name: PageSpeed Insights API
limitations: frequent automation may need a no-cost API key
lab results vary between runs

sources.name: Chrome UX Report API
limitations: requires a no-cost cloud API key
low-traffic URLs may have no record

sources.name: Google Search Console API
limitations: requires verified property access
some low-volume rows are anonymized

sources.name: Google Analytics Data API
limitations: requires property access
tracking configuration affects completeness

sources.name: Bing Webmaster Tools
limitations: requires verified site access
cannot inspect arbitrary competitor properties

sources.name: IndexNow
limitations: requires a key hosted on the target site
receipt does not guarantee crawling or indexing

sources.name: OpenStreetMap data
limitations: public Nominatim is limited to one request per second
systematic grids require an extract or self-hosted service
ODbL attribution applies

sources.name: Local Lighthouse-compatible audit
limitations: requires a user-installed trusted executable
run variance must be reported

sources.name: AutoSEO local evidence snapshots
limitations: history starts at the first saved snapshot
input coverage determines confidence

sources.name: Naver Search API
limitations: legacy keys issued before 2026-07-31 are supported only through 2027-06-30
API HUB is temporarily free and disabled unless the user confirms a no-billing account
daily quotas apply
API samples may differ from personalized integrated search

sources.name: Naver Search Trend API
limitations: legacy and API HUB keys are different
API HUB stays disabled without explicit no-billing confirmation
values are relative trends rather than exact search volume

sources.name: Naver Search Advisor
limitations: requires ownership verification
no public read API; browser reading requires user authorization

sources.name: Public Naver AI Briefing observation
limitations: results vary by query, time, device, location, and personalization
observations do not guarantee future exposure or citation
